title: X launches its own clipping feature to spur influencer engagement | TechCrunch
summary: The platform added that both creators and clippers can “earn from views on the clip through Original Content Rewards,” X’s rewards program . The program is only available for eligible creators and pays out based on specific levels of audience engagement.
